data.name: Maible
data.gender_notes: Maible is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Maible is a name of Old German origin, meaning 'delightful' or 'gentle'. The name has been used primarily in the Western world and has a soft, feminine sound. In Christian contexts, Maible may be seen as a reflection of the gentle and loving nature of God. The name Maible carries the meaning “Delightful, gentle little one” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Maible usually hope their child will grow to embody delightful, gentle little one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that represents the gentle embrace of the divine.
data.etymology: Maible belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Delightful, gentle little one.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Maible total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_hebrew.name: מייבל
in_hebrew.long_meaning: מייבל הוא שם עברי שפירושו 'אמה של יעקב' או 'אם הבנים'. השם מייבל נגזר מהשם העברי 'מאביל' שפירושו 'המביא'. הוא קשור לשם 'מאב' שפירושו 'אב' או 'מקור'. השם מייבל מופיע בתנ'ך ככינויה של רחל, אשתו של יעקב ואם יוסף ובנjamin. השם מייבל משמש גם כסמלה של האמהות והפוריות בקרב העם היהודי.

in_greek.name: Μαίβλ
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Μαίβλ είναι ελληνικό και σημαίνει 'μητέρα των παιδιών' ή 'η μάνα'. Το όνομα Μαίβλ πιθανόν να προέρχεται από το εβραϊκό όνομα 'מאביל' που σημαίνει 'ο φέρων' ή 'ο γεννήτορας'. Στην Καινή Διαθήκη, το όνομα Μαίβλ δεν αναφέρεται συγκεκριμένα, αλλά η έννοια της μάνας και της μητρότητας είναι σημαντική στην πνευματική παράδοση των Χριστιανών.

in_latin.name: Maible
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Maible significat 'mater puerorum' vel 'matris figura'. Nomen Maible originem habet in hebraeo 'מאביל', quod significat 'qui fert' vel 'genitor'. In primitiva Ecclesia Christiana, imago matris et maternitas habent magnam significationem spiritualem, symbolum amoris et nutricis.

in_english.long_meaning: The name Maible originates from the Hebrew 'מאביל' (Ma'avil), meaning 'bringer' or ' mother of children'. It is associated with Rachel, the mother of Joseph and Benjamin in the Bible. Maible symbolizes a loving and nurturing figure, embodying the virtues of motherhood and fertility. Historically, the name Maible has been used in Christian tradition to signify a caring and protective maternal figure.
